_comment: THE schema for '# clip_meta:' header lines in .anim files (A3 item 1, docs/AnimationSystemV3Plan.md). Read by the engine (graphics/ClipMetaSchema.cpp) and by tools/anim_pipeline/clip_meta_schema.py — one source. type: float | bool | string | enum. runtime: the AnimationClip member a numeric key drives (documentation; the C++ mapping is the table in ClipMetaSchema.cpp and a test pins that both agree). toolOnly: authored by tools, never read by the runtime. factor: a composition coordinate stored on AnimationClip::factors; absent means 'any'. Unknown key = WARN (once per key). Wrong type or a value outside an enum = lint ERROR, runtime WARN + ignore.

releaseFrame._comment: cast clips author this; hitFrameFraction on the same line wins

footIKEnabled._comment: A5: 0 = this clip opts out of terrain grounding (dodge/hop); default on

stanceL._comment: left foot plant time; written by anim_lint.py stance --write; drives phase-synced transitions

action._comment: Roadmap R1 decision 6: a class/creature signature action this clip performs (rage, sneak, unarmed_combo, wild_shape, perform, lay_on_hands, second_wind, turn_undead, channel_divinity, deflect). Read by the coverage report via resources/anim/class_actions.json.

review._comment: Roadmap R1 decision 5: the clip's review STATUS. Absent = shipped (existed before review). Promotions write draft; the owner's panel verdict writes approved/rejected. unimate_review.json is the workflow log, this is the status.

state._comment: FSM state name, lower-case (walk, run, idle, ...)

attackKind._comment: Roadmap R1 decision 2: what kind of D&D attack/action this clip performs. Stat-block attack names map to kinds via resources/anim/attack_kinds.json. Humanoid weapon clips need no tag (derived from meleeFamily/weaponFamily).
